region_definition.pure_level: At least one TARGET=0 and zero TARGET=1 at the exact EXT_SOURCE_2 value
region_definition.nearest_default_rule: Nearest exact observed EXT_SOURCE_2 level with at least one TARGET=1 below/above the pure run
region_definition.min_gap: Minimum of finite GAP_BELOW and GAP_ABOVE
region_definition.max_gap: Maximum of finite GAP_BELOW and GAP_ABOVE
region_definition.missing_ext2: Excluded from region discovery and matching

iv_settings.binning: Unsupervised quantile bins, preserving identical values within the same bin
iv_settings.population_scope: All customers; missing values form a special bin
iv_settings.matched_scope: Only customers mapped to a discovered region
iv_settings.within_region_scope: EXT_SOURCE_2 IV calculated separately inside each outer-fold region

important_interpretation: The four gap features are region-level constants. Their within-region IV is undefined. EXT_SOURCE_2 IV is therefore calculated within each region.
leakage_control: Outer-training-only region discovery for validation mapping; inner cross-fitting for outer-training feature generation; validation TARGET used only for post-hoc diagnostics.
